name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching MotoGP races with his father. He pursued a vocational degree in composite engineering, excelling in material science and fabrication. His meticulous approach and keen eye for detail quickly made him a sought-after talent. He joined Sprint V8 Team eager to apply his skills in a high-pressure environment. Ahmad is known for his innovative repair solutions and his ability to adapt to unexpected challenges, making him a valuable asset to the team.

His dedication extends beyond the technical aspects. Ahmad understands the importance of teamwork and clear communication. While comfortable working independently, he is always willing to share his knowledge and assist colleagues. He's constantly seeking ways to improve his skills and contribute to the team's overall success. Ahmad's loyalty to Sprint V8 is unwavering, and he sees himself as an integral part of their future championship aspirations.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his tools after each use, even during time-sensitive situations.
Drinks Teh Tarik from his favorite thermos every morning without fail.
